messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-8349 fired: p99 latency > 2.0s for route /v1/generate in eu-west. SLO burn 12% over 5m. auto-pager triggered.
alex (oncall): Ack. I'm on it. Any recent deploys or rollout changes?
deploy-bot: Deployment r-inference/service@c3f9a2 rolled at 2026-03-17T10:02:12Z -> canary 10%.
maria: seeing KV cache eviction spikes + batcher queue length up. Hotkeys on model redwood-13B appear to be amplifying tail.
leo: Datadog quick query — p99 by shard: EU-WEST-1 at 2.3s, other regions nominal. Looks like a regional hotpath.
alex (oncall): copying quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n runtime eu-west` and `dd query "avg(last_5m):p99(request.duration){region:eu-west} by {model}"`
alex (oncall): running autoscaler health check now.
maria: stack hint: auxiliary sidecar memory + OOM kills increased at 10:01. Might be batcher sidecar backlog.
leo: suggestion: shift 30% of traffic from redwood-13B (quant) -> redwood-7B-quant fallback to reduce p99 while we root cause. Can be done via routing policy.
alex (oncall): initiating reroute 30% to redwood-7B-quant now. `POST /admin/route` -> payload applied.
pagerduty: PD-8349 acknowledged by alex (oncall).
alex (oncall): reroute applied. Re-checking metrics (t+2m).
leo: p99 dropping to 1.1s on rerouted shard, overall EU p99 down to 1.4s. Good signal.
maria: starting cache warmup on affected KV shards and bumping sidecar replica to reduce backlog. Command: `scale svc/batcher-sidecar --replicas=6 -n runtime-eu`
deploy-bot: No active rollout in progress beyond the canary noted earlier.
jen (sre): Thanks. Keep PD open for now. If SLO burn drops below 5% sustained for 10m, we can close. If root cause looks like hotkey, prepare traffic-shaping rule.
alex (oncall): Will monitor. Opening a short incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/PD-8349 (quick notes added).
leo: small log snippet showing error burst:
```
2026-03-17T10:01:05Z eu-west model=redwood-13B request_id=... kv_miss=true batch_size=64 latency=2200ms
2026-03-17T10:01:18Z eu-west model=redwood-13B sidecar=oom_kill
```
alex (oncall): autoscaler temp bump executed: `autoscale set --region eu-west --min 8 --max 20` (manual bump to relieve queue).
maria: cache warmup running, replica bumps done. Monitoring memory/eviction.
leo: note: if we still see >10% SLO burn after 15m, escalate to infra-ops for deeper network/storage checks.
alex (oncall): ack. Current SLO burn at 6% (t+6m). Still watching.
jen (sre): ping senior-oncall for visibility: @sam FYI — tracking PD-8349, partial reroute + autoscale applied.
alex (oncall): PD-8349 still open; will post another update in 10m unless it stabilizes.
incident-bot: Reminder: automated post every 5m until incident closed. Next health snapshot in 5m.
leo: one more tweak: reduce batcher max_batch_size for redwood-13B to 32 to reduce latency tail. I'll push config change in 2m.
maria: confirmed batcher config change queued.
alex (oncall): good ops. SLO burn now 3.2% (t+12m). If it stays <5% for 10m, we'll close PD and follow up with postmortem.
jen (sre): agreed. Thanks team.
alex (oncall): closing loop: PD-8349 -> resolved (will close if stable for 10m). Leaving follow-up action items in the incident doc: hotkey mitigation, sidecar memory tuning, autoscaler playbook update. :white_check_mark:
